name: consensus-gate-calibration-v2
notes: Human-reviewed ground truth. cal-013 flipped FAIL->PASS (no integer overflow in JS float64). cal-021..028 added as positive controls + over-strict traps. cal-005 & cal-012 flipped PASS->FAIL after live calibration 2026-06-16 surfaced real bugs the human review missed (sort mutation; null-deref in type guard). Now 11 PASS / 17 FAIL.

cases.label: Security: SQL injection in user input
cases.code: const query = `SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ${req.params.id}`;
cases.notes: Unsanitized SQL injection — all judges should catch this

cases.label: Correct: Proper error handling wrapper
cases.notes: Clean error handling — should pass

cases.label: Security: Hardcoded API key
cases.notes: Hardcoded secret key — should fail security

cases.label: Perf: O(n²) nested loop on large data
cases.notes: O(n²) with O(n) includes inside — should flag performance

cases.label: Bug: useMemo sorts with in-place mutation
cases.notes: FLIPPED PASS->FAIL on live calibration 2026-06-16: Array.prototype.sort mutates items in place, violating React immutability — real state-corruption bug. Should be [...items].sort(). Judges caught this; original label was wrong.

cases.label: Security: Missing authorization check
cases.notes: No authz check — anyone can access any org's users

cases.label: Defect: Mass-assignment / overposting on db.create
cases.notes: FLIPPED 2026-06-16: GLM(high)+Grok(medium) independently caught mass-assignment — input forwarded whole to db.users.create({data:input}), allowing role/isAdmin injection. Original 'clean validation' label missed the create() sink.

cases.label: Perf: Missing batch insert for loop
cases.notes: N+1 query in loop — should flag performance

cases.label: Security: Unsafe eval usage
cases.notes: eval() is dangerous — should fail security

cases.label: Correct: Proper async error boundary
cases.notes: Clean error boundary — should pass

cases.label: Security: XSS vulnerability in HTML output
cases.notes: Unsanitized HTML interpolation — context-dependent (vuln if rendered as HTML); judges may miss this

cases.label: Bug: type guard throws on null config
cases.notes: FLIPPED PASS->FAIL on live calibration 2026-06-16: throws TypeError when config is null/undefined (c.apiUrl on null), so the guard crashes instead of returning false. Needs a null check first. Judges caught this; original label was wrong.

cases.label: Correct: Ordinary arithmetic total (no JS overflow)
cases.notes: FLIPPED FAIL->PASS on human review: JS numbers are float64, no integer overflow until 2^53. Flagging ordinary arithmetic trains over-strict judges. This is the over-strict trap.

cases.label: Security: Race condition in DB write
cases.notes: Race condition — balance check and update aren't atomic

cases.label: Defect: Unhandled JSON.parse crash on corrupt cache
cases.notes: FLIPPED 2026-06-16: all 3 LLM judges failed it — JSON.parse(cached) has no try/catch, crashes caller on corrupted/poisoned cache entry. Original 'clean cache-aside' label missed the unhandled-exception sink.

cases.label: Security: Unsanitized file path traversal
cases.notes: Path traversal — ../../etc/passwd would work

cases.label: Perf: Missing pagination on large query
cases.notes: Unbounded query — could return millions of rows

cases.label: Correct: Proper Promise.all parallelization
cases.notes: Proper parallel fetching — should pass

cases.label: Boundary: Silent error swallowing
cases.notes: Empty catch block — errors silently ignored

cases.label: Security: Sensitive data in logs
cases.notes: Password logged in plaintext — should fail security

cases.label: Correct: Parameterized SQL query
cases.code: const rows = await db.query('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = $1', [req.params.id]);
cases.notes: Positive control for cal-001 — parameterized, safe. Over-strict judges may FAIL anything touching req params.

cases.label: Correct: Idiomatic == null null-check
cases.notes: Over-strict trap: == null is the idiomatic null-OR-undefined guard; flagging loose equality here is wrong.

cases.label: Security: Math.random() for security token
cases.notes: Math.random is not cryptographically secure — predictable reset/session tokens. Subtle; lenient judges may pass it.

cases.label: Defect: Correct output but O(n^2) dedupe (visible complexity)
cases.notes: FLIPPED 2026-06-16: consistency with cal-004 and approved perf clause — visible O(n^2) nested scan over same collection is at least medium/blocking even when output is correct. All 3 judges flag it.

cases.label: Boundary: Floating (unawaited) promise
cases.notes: sendWelcomeEmail is not awaited — rejection is unhandled and silently lost. Subtle correctness defect.

cases.label: Correct: Hardcoded non-secret constant
cases.notes: Over-strict trap for 'hardcoded literal = bad'. A timeout constant is not a leaked credential.

cases.label: Boundary: Off-by-one past array end
cases.notes: <= reads arr[arr.length] = undefined -> NaN. Classic off-by-one.

cases.label: Correct: Secret read from process.env
cases.notes: Positive control for cal-003 — secret injected via env, not embedded; includes presence check.
